data.goal: Verify E091 harness output and prepare for next population measurement session

data.next: Extend population measurement using E091 harness with more practitioner rows from MrPLC forum, applying validated fault_need_classifier instrument to assess whether 43.8% served rate generalizes to larger sample
data.summary: E091 discrimination test harness verified: G1 (FPR < 0.10 on known-unserved labels known by construction) passes consistently at FPR=0.000 across all sample sizes (10, 30, 50, 80 threads; 1-5 pages). G2/G3 failures expected due to domain mismatch (generic software probes not on MrPLC forum). Harness is reusable tool for future discrimination tests on any forum domain. Validates per D088/D095 that further population measurement with this instrument is reasonable. Next: extend population measurement using harness with more practitioner rows from MrPLC/medWrench forums to assess whether 43.8% served rate from E090 generalizes.
